description: This file defines API routes for analysis-related operations in a backend service, including fetching analysis status, results, canceling analyses, and user analysis retrieval, implemented using FastAPI.

methods.name: get_analysis_status( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and overall score of a specific analysis identified by UUID.

methods.name: get_analysis_results( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), analysis_repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), findings_repo: FindingRepository = Depends(), suggestions_repo: SuggestionRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Fetches the detailed results, including findings and suggestions, of a completed analysis for a given UUID.

methods.name: acknowledge_suggestion( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), suggestion_id: int = Body(..., embed=True) )
methods.description: Provides an endpoint to acknowledge a suggestion associated with an analysis, currently a no-op placeholder.

methods.name: cancel_analysis( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Allows canceling an ongoing analysis by changing its status to 'cancelled'.

methods.name: get_user_analyses( user_id: int = Path(..., alias="userId"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends() )
methods.description: Retrieves all analyses associated with a specific user ID.
